vetSays.line: 🛡️ Gabriela, Asher, Giovanni and Ruth met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Gabriela, Asher, Giovanni, Ruth are hurt.
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.
Giovanni harries the Elder White Noise.
Asher strikes the Elder White Noise.
Giovanni strikes the Elder White Noise.
The Elder White Noise falls.
📺 Asher, Giovanni brought down Elder White Noise. Together. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Elena just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Giovanni, Ruth, Sultana, Tashi and David met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Giovanni, Ruth, Sultana, Tashi are hurt.
🛡️ Gabriela, Sultana, Tashi and David met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Gabriela, Sultana, Tashi, David are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Elena just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Gabriela just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ruth just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Gabriela, Giovanni, Ruth, Sultana and Tashi met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 barely walked away. Gabriela, Giovanni, Ruth, Sultana, Tashi are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ruth just put down Buffering... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Gabriela, Giovanni, Ruth, Tashi and David met them at the door — 5 put down. Gabriela, Giovanni, Ruth, Tashi, David are hurt.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
Tashi was watching. Now they know Ground Elder too.
📚 Village knowledge: Sanne taught everyone about Ground Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.

Katarina has been asking about the strange leaves all week — "but what IS it?" Tonight, an answer. Fireside lesson: Sanne passes around Ground Elder. Someone asks a dumb question. Nobody minds. That's how you learn.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: Ground Elder — named and noted.
🌿 Ground Elder — the foragers have handled it 8 days running. They know it now — which parts are worth hauling, which bruise, how it wants to be carried. The village's knowledge deepens.
💡 Ground Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/3) and it'll click.
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Brian taught everyone about European Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: European Elder — named and noted.
Dmitri showed Katarina the European Elder — "remember it." Word travels before the lesson cools.
Fireside lesson: Brian passes around European Elder. Someone asks a dumb question. Nobody minds. That's how you learn.
✨ Ability gained: Cold-Blooded (L1). You need 20% less food in cold weather. Your body budgets like an accountant.
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
Sanne strikes the Scarred The Big Beast.
It saw the opening coming — braced, scar tissue white. Your first strike glances off. (SCARRED: -3 first strike)
The Scarred The Big Beast falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Scarred The Big Beast!
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Owen just put down Ugly-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Owen, Liam and Baldur met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 barely walked away. Liam, Baldur are hurt.
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.
The Elder Sunbasker falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Elder Sunbasker!
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
